text: Which statement about the enteric nervous system (ENS) is correct and helps explain its status as a case of somatic cognition?
choices: It contains only a few thousand neurons that passively relay commands from the brain
It can operate only when directly driven by the central nervous system
About 90% of vagus-nerve fibers carry signals from the brain down to the gut
It contains roughly 100 million neurons and can coordinate gut function independently of the central nervous system
explanation: The ENS holds about 100 million neurons (more than the spinal cord), contains all major neurotransmitter types, and coordinates peristalsis, secretion, and immune surveillance semi-autonomously. Notably, roughly 90% of vagal fibers run gut-to-brain, not brain-to-gut, so the option reversing that direction is wrong, as are the claims that it is small or wholly brain-dependent.
